⛔ SNG-440. PHYSICAL RANGED CRAFT — Erik: 'I want more physical skills. Some can use agility, such as throwing knives, stars, stones. Some should be bow or crossbow style. Some are various raw power thrown.'
⚠️ MEASURED FIRST: of 376 abilities, only 45 are `physical` (12%, against 161 mental), and exactly ONE was a genuine ranged physical attack. 21 of 31 traditions have NO physical ability at all.
⛔ AUTHORED AS `valley_craft` ON PURPOSE. Valley craft is 'skill and nothing else' — no power system, no tradition gate — so these are available to ANY character and they close the coverage gap at the same time as the physical one. A Cogitant can now throw a knife. ⚠️ ALL SIX ROLL DICE on the existing ladder (L1 1d6, L2 2d6), because Erik's standard is that a skill DOES what its label says.

⛔ RE-ROOTED, SNG-443. ERIK: 'Skills may be learned at PLACES — or in the wilds as a hunter — but they would be TIED BACK TO THEIR TRADITION ROOTS otherwise.'
⚠️ THAT IS TWO AXES AND I HAD COLLAPSED THEM INTO ONE. `tradition` is the LINEAGE a craft descends from; `learnedAt` is where a person can actually acquire it. ⛔ FILING EVERYTHING AS valley_craft BECAUSE IT WAS OPEN TO ANYONE CONFUSED ACCESS WITH ANCESTRY.
⛔ AND IT DISSOLVES THE HUNTER'S STRIKE COLLISION RATHER THAN PATCHING IT: Hunter's Strike is a working hunter's shot, valley-rooted, learned in the wilds, taken for meat. The Drawn Bow is line-holding doctrine at range, marcher-rooted, learned at Hardline for money. ⚠️ SAME WEAPON, DIFFERENT CRAFT, DIFFERENT ROOT — they were never duplicates, they were two crafts I had mislabelled as one.

crit.success: They commit harder than they meant to, and their second rank is still crossing open ground.
crit.failure: They take the bait and bring twice what you measured for.

mechanic.note: setup/provoke. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'DON'T NARROW THEM TO DUELS AND NO CONCEAL. **SUN TZU IS REVERED BY THEM — MILITARY STRATEGY HAS A HOME HERE.**' ⚠️ I HAD ARGUED THE MARCHERS REFUSE `deceive` because 'truth runs high' at the Marchward and they wear 'scars as record'. ⛔ THAT CONFLATED TWO DIFFERENT HONESTIES: they are PLAIN-SPOKEN PERSONALLY AND DECEPTIVE PROFESSIONALLY, which is not a contradiction — it is the whole of the strategic tradition. ⚠️ THE CRAFT GIVES THEM `provoke` AND `deceive` IN ONE ACT, and it is deliberately not a duel-challenge: Erik ruled against narrowing it, and forcing an ARMY onto ground you chose is the same skill as forcing a man to swing.

tree.name: Chosen Ground
tree.grants: ⛔ SHOW THEM A REASON TO COME AT YOU HERE — an opening, an apparent weakness, a target too good to leave — and take a named advantage on the opening exchange if they take it.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ They must be willing to fight at all. ⛔ Spent the moment it is read, and it does nothing to anyone already engaged.

tree.name: Which Road
tree.grants: ⛔ SHAPE WHICH OF SEVERAL APPROACHES THEY TAKE — close a road with a rumour, open one with a carelessly placed cart, and meet them at the one you prepared. ⚠️ This is where the Marchers stop being warriors and start being a military.
tree.cannot: ⛔ You must know all the approaches. ⚠️ A commander who splits his force takes several of them.

tree.name: Prepared Beforehand
tree.grants: ⛔ A WHOLE FORCE AND ITS COMMANDER, AND THE GROUND MADE READY DAYS AHEAD — stakes cut, fords fouled, the line of retreat already decided by you. ⚠️ The fight is largely over when it starts, which is the point.
tree.cannot: ⛔ IT IS STILL AN OFFER. A commander who refuses battle entirely has beaten this, and the Marchers consider that a legitimate answer — it is the one Stillhold gives.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29. ⚠️ CORRECTS MY OWN ARGUMENT: I said the Marchers REFUSE `conceal`/`deceive` and should get a duel-challenge craft. Erik: don't narrow to duels, and Sun Tzu is revered — military strategy has a home here. ⛔ AND HE ADDED THE THING I HAD NOT CONSIDERED: 'they can ENLIST OTHER TRADITIONS' SKILLS AND BRAID.' A tradition does not need to own every verb; a strategist's answer to a missing capability is to RECRUIT SOMEONE WHO HAS IT. See `_strategistsBraid`.
abilities._strategistsBraid: ⛔ ERIK: 'BESIDES, THEY CAN ENLIST OTHER TRADITIONS' SKILLS AND BRAID.' ⚠️ THIS IS A GENERAL CORRECTION TO HOW I RUN GAP ASSESSMENTS: I have been treating an absent verb as a hole in a tradition. **For the Marchers specifically it is a doctrine** — a people whose art is the disposition of force do not need to own `conceal` when they can put an Umbral on the flank, and `powerSystem: combination` braids already exist (`harbored_flame`, `turning_word`, `meaning_engine`) as the mechanism. ⚠️ SO A MARCHER GAP LIST SHOULD READ AS 'WHO WOULD THEY RECRUIT FOR THIS', NOT 'WHAT ARE THEY MISSING'.

abilities.name: Small Company
abilities.description: ⛔ A LINE IS NOT A PARTY, AND THE DRILL DOES NOT TRANSFER. A soldier trained to hold shoulder-to-shoulder with forty others has to learn to fight beside four people who each do something entirely different — a shadow-worker, a mender, someone who talks to the dead. ⚠️ THIS IS THAT TRAINING. Read what the people beside you actually do, and place yourself so their work lands. ⛔ IT IS THE CRAFT THAT TURNS A SOLDIER INTO SOMEONE WORTH TAKING ON A QUEST.
abilities.narrationHints: He does not tell them what to do — they are better at their own work than he is. ⚠️ He simply keeps ending up in the place where their work becomes possible, and none of them notice him doing it.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT IS NOT COMMAND AND THEY ARE NOT YOURS — nobody in a party takes orders, and a Marcher who tries discovers that immediately. ⚠️ IT WORKS ON A HANDFUL: five, six, the size of a party. Give it a company and it does nothing, which is the exact inverse of `held_line`. ⛔ AND YOU MUST HAVE SEEN THEM WORK — it reads people you know, and a stranger who joined this morning is a stranger.
abilities.plainly: A fight/travel action. ⛔ POSITION YOURSELF SO YOUR COMPANIONS' OWN CRAFTS LAND BETTER — a named advantage for each ally acting this round, chosen for what they actually do. Rated 4, up to five companions, holds through a fight. r2 works while travelling and out of combat; r3 the party keeps the advantage when you are DOWN. ⚠️ Not orders, not command, and useless on a formation.

intensity.surge: read the whole party at once; ⛔ YOU WILL DO NOTHING ELSE THIS ROUND BUT PUT PEOPLE WHERE THEY SHOULD BE

bounds.text: ⛔ NOT COMMAND — nobody in a party takes orders, and it does not make them
⛔ A HANDFUL ONLY. Give it a company and it does nothing — the exact inverse of `held_line`
⚠️ YOU MUST HAVE SEEN THEM WORK. It reads people you know

crit.success: The whole party moves like it has done this for years, and two of them will privately wonder why.
crit.failure: You place yourself perfectly for the fight you expected and are nowhere useful in this one.

mechanic.note: bolster. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29, ANSWERING THE STRUCTURAL GAP: 'SOLDIERS MOVE ON TO BE HEROES, EPICS, LEGENDARIES — QUESTING. What skills would help them do that?' ⚠️ SO ADVANCEMENT IS NOT LEAVING THE TRADE, IT IS THE TRADE GOING OUT. ⛔ THIS IS THE TRANSITION CRAFT: the drill that works in a line does not work in a party of five specialists, and nothing in the tradition bridged it. `held_line` steadies people doing THE SAME THING; this reads people doing DIFFERENT things.

tree.name: Small Company
tree.grants: ⛔ PLACE YOURSELF SO THEIR CRAFTS LAND — a named advantage for each companion acting this round, chosen for what they actually do rather than what you would do.
tree.cannot: Five at most, people you have seen work. ⛔ It gives no orders and grants no obedience.

tree.name: On the Road
tree.grants: ⛔ IT WORKS OUTSIDE A FIGHT — watches set right, loads distributed, the argument headed off before the third day. ⚠️ A party that travels with a Marcher arrives in better condition and rarely knows why.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It smooths a party; it does not make them like each other.

tree.name: They Keep the Shape
tree.grants: ⛔ THE PARTY HOLDS THE ADVANTAGE WHILE YOU ARE DOWN — you have taught it to them without either side calling it teaching. ⚠️ This is the rank where a soldier stops being a companion and starts being the reason the company survives.
tree.cannot: ⛔ It lasts the fight, not the campaign. ⚠️ And it cannot help a party that has stopped trusting each other.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29 — the questing-soldier's transition craft. Answers the structural gap that soldiering topped out at L2.

abilities.name: Told Of
abilities.description: ⛔ A DEED ONLY COUNTS WHERE IT IS TOLD. The Marchers keep scars as record and know exactly what that is worth: nothing, in a village that has never heard of you. ⚠️ THIS IS THE CRAFT OF BEING KNOWN CORRECTLY — naming what you did plainly to the people who should hear it, in the form that travels, without embellishment that a witness could contradict. ⛔ AND IT IS HOW A SOLDIER BECOMES A NAME: standing spreads by being carried, and a deed nobody carried is a deed that never happened.
abilities.narrationHints: He tells it in about four sentences, names the two people who died, and does not mention what he did. ⚠️ By spring it is being told back to him in three villages, and in all three he comes out better than he said.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT CARRIES WHAT IS TRUE. A deed you did not do will not spread — it will be checked, because the people who carry stories are the people who compare them. ⚠️ AND IT SPREADS WHERE THERE ARE PEOPLE TO CARRY IT: a thing done alone in the Zone with no witness and no survivor stays where it happened. ⛔ Nor does it choose the shape it takes. Once it is moving it belongs to whoever is telling it, and they will improve it.
abilities.plainly: A social/travel action. ⛔ A DEED YOU ACTUALLY DID SPREADS TO THE COMMUNITIES THAT SHOULD HEAR IT, and your standing rises with them. Rated 5, and it keeps moving after you leave. r2 reaches communities you have never visited; r3 the telling arrives BEFORE you do. ⚠️ It carries only what is true, needs someone to carry it, and you do not control the version that arrives.

intensity.conserve: tell it once, to the people it concerns
intensity.surge: tell it everywhere you can reach; ⛔ YOUR ENEMIES WILL HEAR IT TOO, AND THEY WILL KNOW WHERE YOU HAVE BEEN

bounds.text: ⛔ ONLY WHAT IS TRUE TRAVELS. An invented deed gets checked and costs you the standing you had
⛔ IT NEEDS CARRIERS. A deed with no witness and no survivor does not spread
⚠️ YOU DO NOT OWN THE VERSION THAT ARRIVES — it belongs to whoever tells it next

crit.success: It is carried further than you have ever been, and someone you will never meet acts on it.
crit.failure: It arrives ahead of you in the mouth of someone who was there and disliked you.

mechanic.note: setup. ⛔ AUTHORED AGAINST THE ACTUAL TIER MECHANISM, not an idea of one: `derivedLevel` in `npcsheet.js` raises a figure by DEEDS, TIME KNOWN, and **`standing`** — and standing propagates by `communityId`, which is visibly how Silas's grove-ward spread to forty communities in play. ⚠️ SO THE CRAFT THAT MAKES A SOLDIER INTO A LEGEND IS NOT A WEAPON — IT IS THE ONE THAT MOVES STANDING. ⛔ And its hard bound is the tradition's own honesty: only what is true travels, because 'the people who carry stories are the people who compare them.'

tree.name: Told Of
tree.grants: ⛔ NAME WHAT YOU DID, PLAINLY, TO THE PEOPLE WHO SHOULD HEAR IT — and it spreads to the communities it concerns, raising your standing with them. ⚠️ Understatement carries further than boast; the Marchers know this and teach it.
tree.cannot: ⛔ It must be true and it must have been witnessed. ⚠️ You do not control the retelling.

tree.name: Carried Further
tree.grants: ⛔ IT REACHES PLACES YOU HAVE NEVER BEEN — traders carry it, a road carries it, and you arrive somewhere for the first time already owed a hearing.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ And already owed a grudge, in the places that side against you.

tree.name: Arrives Before You
tree.grants: ⛔ THE TELLING GETS THERE FIRST. Doors are open, terms are better, and some fights do not start because of what the other side has already heard. ⚠️ THIS IS THE MECHANISM OF THE LEGEND TIERS MADE INTO A CRAFT.
tree.cannot: ⛔ AND YOU CANNOT BE ANONYMOUS AFTERWARDS. A Marcher at this rank has given up ever walking into a room unknown, which is a real cost to anyone who ever needs to.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'soldiers move on to be HEROES, EPICS, LEGENDARIES… questing. What skills would help them do that?' ⚠️ READ THE MECHANISM FIRST (rule 11): tier rises on deeds, time and STANDING, and standing propagates by community. ⛔ SO THE ANSWER WAS NOT ANOTHER WEAPON.
abilities._gainAxesFix_20260829: ⛔ r3 declared , which is NOT one of the nine KINDS OF IMPROVEMENT. ⚠️ THIRD TIME I HAVE MADE THIS EXACT ERROR — and this one came AFTER I renamed the two vocabularies and wrote PIPELINE rule 7 about naming them properly. ⛔ The nine are range · duration · damage · scope · targets · quality · autonomy · conditions · tempo.  is narrative vocabulary from the  side and was RULED PROSE. The rank means .

abilities.name: Breach
abilities.description: ⛔ YOU HAVE HELD A LINE, SO YOU KNOW WHAT HOLDS ONE. A formation is not strong because of the men in it — it is strong because each of them believes the two beside him will still be there. ⚠️ TAKE THAT AWAY AND THE REST FOLLOWS: a shove at the joint, a shout in the wrong voice, one man pulled out of the rank at the moment the press comes. ⛔ THIS IS `held_line` READ FROM THE OTHER SIDE, AND ONLY SOMEONE WHO HAS DONE THE HOLDING CAN DO IT.
abilities.narrationHints: She does not attack the shield wall. ⚠️ She hits the third man from the end twice, steps back, and waits. ⛔ Eleven seconds later the whole right flank is a crowd.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT BREAKS FORMATIONS, NOT PEOPLE — every one of them is still armed, still angry, and now unformed and much harder to predict. ⚠️ A BROKEN LINE IS NOT A ROUTED ONE: they can re-form, and a good serjeant will. ⛔ AND IT NEEDS A FORMATION TO BREAK: a mob is already a crowd, and three people in a corridor are not a line. Nor does it touch anything that does not believe in the man beside it — the raised, the driven, a mechanism.
abilities.plainly: A fight/defend action. ⛔ BREAK AN ENEMY FORMATION — they lose the benefits of holding together and fight as individuals. Rated 6, a line's worth, about four rounds. r2 stops them re-forming while you hold it; r3 breaks a formation you are NOT engaged with, from across the field. ⚠️ They are still armed. It does nothing to the raised, the driven, or anything that does not rely on the man beside it.

intensity.conserve: break one section — a flank, a gate-rank, the end of a wall
intensity.surge: break everything holding on the field; ⛔ INCLUDING ANY LINE YOUR OWN PEOPLE ARE STANDING IN

bounds.text: ⛔ IT BREAKS THE FORMATION, NOT THE FIGHTERS — they are all still armed and now unpredictable
⛔ IT NEEDS A REAL FORMATION. A mob is already a crowd
⚠️ NOTHING THAT DOES NOT RELY ON THE MAN BESIDE IT — the raised, the driven and mechanisms are untouched
⚠️ A BROKEN LINE CAN RE-FORM, and a good serjeant will

crit.success: It goes at the joint and takes the neighbouring section with it.
crit.failure: You pull the wrong man and the line closes tighter than it was.

mechanic.note: hobble. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'the higher level soldier skills should also BREAK AND DISRUPT UNITS AND FORMATIONS — they've BEEN THERE and know what it takes to hold and to break.' ⚠️ IT IS `held_line` INVERTED, and the fiction is the veteran's: the knowledge is the same knowledge, used from the other side. ⛔ AND IT IS THE PLAYER-FACING EDGE OF THE GROUP MODEL — a formation's benefit is exactly what `standingContributions` aggregates, and this removes it without killing anyone.
mechanic._requiresSelfNote: ⛔ `requiresSelf` — PROPOSED, underscore-prefixed: CCode builds the reader and the agreement gate, and I am not declaring a field in the schema unilaterally again. ⚠️ THE CRAFT ALREADY SAYS THIS IN PROSE. Measured 2026-08-30: SIX CRAFTS STATE THE SAME RULE IN FOUR DIFFERENT PHRASINGS — 'without a self', 'has no self', 'anything without a mind', 'anything that does not rely on the man beside it' — and `the_narrowed` states the other half as `feeling: immune` IN DATA. ⛔ NOTHING CHECKS THE TWO AGREE AND NOTHING EVER WILL WHILE ONE SIDE IS PROSE. ✅ With `hasSelf` on the bestiary classes, a gate can assert it: every craft requiring a self must be answered by every creature that has none. ⚠️ ERIK'S TEST, WHICH THIS PASSES: does it let content say ONCE what it currently says many times in prose?

tree.name: Breach
tree.grants: ⛔ AN ENEMY FORMATION COMES APART — they lose everything they were getting from holding together and fight as individuals. ⚠️ Nobody is hurt. Everybody is worse.
tree.cannot: A real formation, four rounds. ⛔ They can re-form. ⚠️ And they are all still armed.

tree.name: Not Again
tree.grants: ⛔ THEY CANNOT RE-FORM WHILE YOU HOLD IT — every attempt to dress the line goes wrong in a way that looks like bad luck to them and looks like arithmetic to you.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It takes your attention. ⛔ And a commander who orders them to fight as individuals has adapted.

tree.name: From Across the Field
tree.grants: ⛔ BREAK A FORMATION YOU ARE NOT ENGAGED WITH — read it from a ridge, name the joint, and send one person to do the thing that opens it. ⚠️ This is where a Marcher stops being a fighter on the field and becomes a reason the field went that way.
tree.cannot: ⛔ You must be able to SEE it. ⚠️ And someone has to go and do the thing.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29 — the veteran's knowledge inverted. `held_line` read from the other side.
abilities._renamed_20260830: ⚠️ `Break the Line` → `Breach`. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-30: 'make the skill names better and MORE FANTASTIC — like BREACH instead of break the line. But otherwise if the skill name is good we should update the RANK NAME in the dup craft.' ✅ This craft was the weaker side of a name collision, so the CRAFT was renamed rather than the rank.

abilities.name: Who Falls First
abilities.description: ⛔ LOOK AT A GROUP AND KNOW WHO IT CANNOT AFFORD TO LOSE. Not the biggest, not the loudest — the one whose absence takes something the rest cannot replace: the mender, the one carrying the signal, the only person there who can open the gate. ⚠️ A MARCHER KNOWS THIS BECAUSE THEY HAVE BEEN IN THE UNIT THAT LOST THAT PERSON, and remembers what the next hour was like. ⛔ IT CUTS BOTH WAYS AND THE TRADITION TEACHES IT AS ONE SKILL: the same read tells you who to put behind you.
abilities.narrationHints: He looks at nine armed men for about two seconds. ⚠️ 'The thin one at the back with the satchel,' he says. ⛔ Nobody else had noticed the satchel.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT NAMES WHO MATTERS, IT DOES NOT HELP YOU REACH THEM — the answer is usually the person standing furthest back behind the most people, which is the whole reason they are placed there. ⚠️ AND IT READS CAPABILITY, NOT VALUE: it will name a stranger's mender and say nothing about the man's children. ⛔ It is blind to anything it has no reference for — a craft nobody in the unit has seen used reads as nothing at all.
abilities.plainly: A fight/defend action. ⛔ NAME THE MEMBER OF A GROUP WHOSE LOSS COSTS THEM MOST — and take a named advantage on acting against them, OR on protecting that person if they are yours. Rated 5, one group. r2 names the order — first, second, third; r3 reads a group you have only heard described. ⚠️ It tells you WHO, never how to get there.

intensity.surge: read every group on the field at once; ⛔ YOU WILL KNOW THE ORDER FOR ALL OF THEM AND HAVE ONE ROUND TO USE IT

bounds.text: ⛔ IT NAMES WHO, NEVER HOW TO REACH THEM — and the answer is usually the best-protected person there
⛔ CAPABILITY, NOT VALUE. It reads what a group would lose, not what a person is worth
⚠️ BLIND TO WHAT IT HAS NO REFERENCE FOR — an unfamiliar craft reads as nothing

crit.success: You name someone the enemy commander had not realised was load-bearing either.
crit.failure: You name the decoy, who is standing exactly where a mender would stand.

mechanic.note: setup/reveal. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'AND WHO TO PROTECT AND WHO TO TARGET.' ⚠️ THIS IS THE GROUP CAPABILITY MODEL MADE PLAYER-FACING: `standingContributions` returns `{families, lost}` and the spec's central distinction is COVERAGE versus DEPTH — losing the only mender is a CLIFF, losing one of six spears is a slope. ⛔ THIS CRAFT READS THE CLIFF. And the veteran's fiction earns it exactly: a Marcher knows which loss is a cliff because they have been in the unit that took one.
mechanic._notRequiresSelf_20260830: ⛔ `requiresSelf` REMOVED — MIS-ASSIGNED. ⚠️ It reads a group's CAPABILITY — which member's loss costs the rest most — and A CREW OF CONSTRUCTS HAS CAPABILITIES TOO. The one that carries the signal, the one that can open the gate: that reasoning holds perfectly against things with no interiority. ⛔ ERIK'S RULE MADE THE ERROR VISIBLE: I had been treating `requiresSelf` as 'is this craft about minds', when it means 'DOES THIS NEED THE TARGET TO HAVE ONE'.

tree.name: Who Falls First
tree.grants: ⛔ NAME THE ONE WHOSE LOSS COSTS A GROUP MOST, and take a named advantage acting against them — or protecting them, if they are yours.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It does not help you reach them. ⛔ Capability only; it says nothing about who anyone is.

tree.name: And Then
tree.grants: ⛔ THE ORDER, NOT JUST THE NAME — first, second, third, and what each loss opens. ⚠️ A Marcher at this rank can tell you what a fight will look like four losses from now.
tree.cannot: ⛔ The order changes when the fight does. ⚠️ And it assumes they do not adapt, which good ones do.

tree.name: From the Telling
tree.grants: ⛔ READ A GROUP YOU HAVE ONLY HEARD DESCRIBED — from a scout's report, a prisoner's account, a rumour with enough detail in it. ⚠️ You will know who matters in a company you have never seen.
tree.cannot: ⛔ THE READING IS ONLY AS GOOD AS THE TELLING. ⚠️ And a deliberately false account produces a confident, specific, wrong answer.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'and WHO TO PROTECT AND WHO TO TARGET.' ⚠️ It is the coverage-cliff distinction from the group aggregation spec, made into a craft — and the veteran's fiction earns it rather than decorating it.
abilities._surgeFix_20260829: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'WHY WOULD YOU CARE ABOUT UNSEEING IT?' ⚠️ My surge was 'you will see who your own side cannot afford to lose, and you will not be able to unsee it' — I gave a veteran a CONSCIENCE where they would have a CALCULATION. ⛔ A Marcher who has been in the unit that lost its mender does not find the knowledge troubling; they find it USEFUL. The surge now buys REACH and is limited by TIME, which is what a surge should cost.

abilities.name: In the Way
abilities.description: ⛔ PUT SOMETHING ELSE WHERE THE BLOW IS GOING. A shove at the right instant, a grip on a strap, a table kicked into the lane — the harm meant for you arrives somewhere else and you are still standing. ⚠️ A MARCHER LEARNS THIS THE SAME WAY THEY LEARN EVERYTHING: by watching it work. ⛔ IT IS THE EXACT INVERSE OF THE STILLHOLD'S `step_between`, AND BOTH TRADITIONS KNOW IT. One steps in front of someone; the other puts someone in front.
abilities.narrationHints: The bolt takes the man he was arguing with a moment earlier. ⚠️ Nobody saw him move and he did not move much — half a step and a hand on a shoulder, at the right instant.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT NEEDS SOMETHING TO PUT THERE — a person, an animal, a heavy object, within reach and not braced against you. An empty lane offers nothing. ⚠️ AND IT ANSWERS ONE INCOMING THING, AIMED: a blow, a bolt, a thrown weapon. Not an area, not a working laid on the ground, not something that was never coming at you. ⛔ WHOEVER YOU PUT THERE TAKES IT IN FULL, and if they live they know exactly what you did.
abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action. ⛔ REDIRECT ONE AIMED ATTACK MEANT FOR YOU INTO SOMETHING ELSE WITHIN REACH — a person, an animal, a heavy object. Rated 5, once per exchange, about four rounds. r2 redirects onto a chosen target rather than the nearest; r3 redirects an attack meant for an ALLY as well as one meant for you. ⚠️ Whoever ends up there takes it in full.

intensity.conserve: a partial deflection — they take some of it and so do you
intensity.surge: ⛔ REDIRECT EVERY AIMED THING THIS ROUND; whatever is nearest takes all of it

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU NEED SOMETHING WITHIN REACH TO PUT THERE. An empty lane offers nothing
⛔ AIMED ATTACKS ONLY — not areas, not ground-workings, not what was never coming at you
⚠️ WHOEVER TAKES IT, TAKES IT IN FULL — including your own people, including someone who trusted you
⚠️ IT IS SEEN BY ANYONE WATCHING FOR IT, and the Marchers are watching for it

crit.success: It lands on the one person the other side could least afford to lose, and you did not have to choose.
crit.failure: You commit to the pull and the attack was never aimed at you.

mechanic.note: hobble/redirect. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'a veteran can also PULL SOMEONE OR SOMETHING ELSE INTO HARM'S PATH TO TAKE A HIT THAT IS MEANT FOR THEM.' ⚠️ THE EXACT INVERSE OF `step_between` (stillhold), which is the violence/peace axis working as designed: the peace pole interposes ITSELF, the violence pole interposes SOMEBODY ELSE, and they are the same insight about where a blow is going. ⛔ IT IS DELIBERATELY NOT PUNISHED — no reputation cost, no standing hit, no narrative debt. It is a cold craft in a warrior culture and the cost is that PEOPLE SEE YOU DO IT.
mechanic._interceptInverted_20260829: ⛔ AUTHORS `interceptDamage` — THE SAME MACHINERY AS `step_between`, WITH THE ROLES REVERSED. CCode's battle test, 2026-08-29: 'in_the_way describes the SAME machinery pointed the other way and AUTHORS NOTHING, so it resolves as a generic hinder. The fix is one authored block, not engine work.' ⚠️ THE INVERSION IS THE WHOLE CRAFT: `openProtection({protectorId, allyId})` normally has the caster as PROTECTOR and the person they cover as ALLY. Here the caster is the ALLY and the person shoved into the path is the PROTECTOR — **made a protector without consenting to be one.** ⛔ THAT IS THE VIOLENCE/PEACE AXIS IN ONE FIELD: stillhold volunteers to be the protector; the marcher NOMINATES SOMEONE.

tree.name: In the Way
tree.grants: ⛔ REDIRECT ONE AIMED ATTACK MEANT FOR YOU INTO WHATEVER IS NEAREST — a body, a beast, a laden cart. ⚠️ You do not choose what; you choose the instant.
tree.cannot: Once per exchange. ⛔ Something must be within reach. ⚠️ Whatever takes it, takes all of it.

tree.name: That One
tree.grants: ⛔ YOU CHOOSE WHO — not the nearest, the one you want it to hit. ⚠️ Combined with knowing who a group cannot afford to lose, this is a way to kill someone with their own side's arrow.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ They must be within reach and not braced. ⛔ And everyone sees where it went.

tree.name: Not Him Either
tree.grants: ⛔ REDIRECT WHAT WAS AIMED AT AN ALLY, NOT ONLY AT YOU — a Marcher at this rank decides who in the room takes the incoming, and it need not be either of the two people it concerned.
tree.cannot: ⛔ STILL ONE AIMED THING AT A TIME, still needs a body within reach. ⚠️ And an ally you save this way watches you put it into someone else.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29. ⚠️ AND HE CORRECTED THE INSTINCT THAT WOULD HAVE RUINED IT: asked why a veteran would care about 'unseeing' who is vulnerable, i.e. STOP GIVING THESE PEOPLE A CONSCIENCE THEY DO NOT HAVE. This craft carries no penalty, no standing loss and no narrative debt — per the standing rule that a cost is ENERGY. What it costs is that people watch you do it.
abilities._wiredFromBattleTest_20260829: ⚠️ I HAD THIS AS 'NO ENGINE HOOK' AND WAS WRONG IN THE WORSE DIRECTION. CCode: 'none of them is inert — THE DIVISION IS GENERIC vs SPECIFIC, and a GENERIC RESOLUTION IS WORSE THAN AN INERT ONE BECAUSE IT LOOKS LIKE IT WORKED.' ⛔ This craft rolled, dealt its magnitude and printed a receipt, and nothing redirected anything.
abilities._friendlyFire_20260830: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-30: 'KEEP IN THE WAY ABLE TO TARGET ALLIES.' ⚠️ I had removed it under the no-harm-your-own rule and that was over-application: THIS CRAFT IS FRIENDLY FIRE AS A DELIBERATE ACT, chosen by the player, and it is the whole point of it. ✅ THE RULE IS ABOUT CRAFTS THAT HIT YOUR SIDE WITHOUT YOU CHOOSING IT — an area that 'does not sort'. It is not about a craft whose SUBJECT is deciding who takes the blow. ⛔ The violence pole interposes SOMEBODY ELSE, and the player picks who.

abilities.name: Shieldwork
abilities.description: ⛔ A SHIELD IS A WEAPON THAT ALSO STOPS THINGS. The rim breaks a nose, the boss breaks a stance, and the face of it puts a man on his back with his own momentum. ⚠️ THE REDLINE TEACHES IT AS ONE SKILL — there is no drill for holding it that is not also a drill for hitting with it. ⛔ AND IT IS WORTH MORE BESIDE SOMEONE ELSE CARRYING ONE: two shields overlap, and the overlap is the oldest advantage in the trade.
abilities.narrationHints: She takes the axe on the boss, turns it, and the rim is already moving. ⚠️ The man beside her does not have to look — he knows what her left side is doing because it is what his left side is doing.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ YOU MUST HAVE A SHIELD, AND A REAL ONE — a board, a buckler, a door if it comes to it, but not a cloak and not a notion. ⚠️ IT WANTS A FRONT: a shield answers what is in front of it, and a Marcher surrounded is a Marcher with a shield facing the wrong way. ⛔ AND THE OVERLAP NEEDS SOMEONE WHO KNOWS IT — an ally with a shield and no training gets you a bonus and gets themselves nothing.
abilities.plainly: A fight/defend action. ⛔ STRIKE WITH THE SHIELD FOR 2d6 AND SOAK WITH IT IN THE SAME ACTION — attack and defence are one craft. Rated 5, about six rounds. r2 staggers, and lets you TAKE A BLOW MEANT FOR A COMPANION on your soak; r3 covers TWO companions at once while you strike from behind it. ⚠️ You take what you catch, in full.

intensity.conserve: guard only — no strike this exchange, and the soak holds
intensity.surge: ⛔ STRIKE WITH EVERYTHING AND DROP THE GUARD; the shield is a weapon this round and nothing else

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU MUST HAVE A REAL SHIELD. A board, a buckler, a door — not a cloak, not a notion
⛔ IT ANSWERS WHAT IS IN FRONT OF IT. Surrounded, you are holding it the wrong way
⚠️ COVERING SOMEONE IS TAKING THE BLOW YOURSELF — on your shield, on your soak, in full. It is not a bonus they receive
⚠️ STRIKING WITH IT MEANS MOVING IT, and a shield in motion is not covering anything

crit.success: The rim takes him under the jaw and the man behind him steps back into someone.
crit.failure: You commit the shield to the strike and the second one comes in where it was.

mechanic.note: guard/strike. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'Make a SHIELD WIELDING SKILL. ATTACK AND DEFENSE and a BONUS NEXT TO OTHERS WIELDING SHIELDS for both.' ⚠️ THE MARCHERS HAD NO MELEE WEAPON CRAFT AT ALL: `edge` is the DISCIPLINE, and the ranged side had three distinct crafts while spear, axe, sword and shield shared none. ⛔ AND IT SITS AT L3, WHERE THE TRADITION HAD A HOLE — the level-distribution defect, not the damage curve, which is on-curve throughout (see BACKLOG). ⚠️ THE OVERLAP IS THE DESIGN: it is the only craft in the tradition that pays BOTH parties for standing together, which is what a shield wall actually is.
mechanic._overlapReauthored_20260829: ⛔ THE OVERLAP WAS RE-AUTHORED. CCode's battle test 2026-08-29: 'You are right. NOTHING READS ADJACENCY. `melee.js` has NO POSITIONAL CONCEPT WHATSOEVER — no facing, no line, no neighbours. Re-author it. There is nothing to hook and nothing planned that would give it one.' ⚠️ I HAD AUTHORED 'beside another shield-carrier you BOTH gain', which is a bonus keyed to a spatial relationship the engine cannot express — it resolved as a generic guard and read as if it worked. ✅ NOW IT USES `interceptDamage`, WHICH IS BUILT: r2 takes a blow meant for ONE companion, r3 for TWO. ⛔ THE FICTION SURVIVES AND IMPROVES — a shield wall is not a proximity aura, it is PEOPLE HOLDING BLOWS OFF EACH OTHER, and that is now literally what it does.

tree.name: Shieldwork
tree.grants: ⛔ STRIKE FOR 2d6 AND SOAK IN THE SAME ACTION — rim, boss and face are all of them weapons. ⚠️ BESIDE ANOTHER TRAINED SHIELD-CARRIER, YOU BOTH GAIN: soak and strike improve for each of you.
tree.cannot: You need a real shield and a front. ⛔ Striking moves it, and a moving shield covers nothing.

tree.name: Cover the Open Side
tree.grants: ⛔ THE STRIKE STAGGERS — they lose the initiative, not just the hit — AND YOU MAY TAKE A BLOW MEANT FOR ONE COMPANION, on your shield, resolved against your soak. ⚠️ This is what a shield is FOR beyond your own skin, and it is why two of them are worth more than two people.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ One companion, and you must be able to reach the blow. ⛔ You take it in full, on your soak, and striking moves the shield.

tree.name: Wall
tree.grants: ⛔ COVER TWO COMPANIONS AT ONCE AND STRIKE FROM BEHIND IT — the line the Redline is famous for is a set of people each holding a blow off the next. ⚠️ A wall of these does not need to advance; it needs you to come to it.
tree.cannot: ⛔ IT IS STILL A FRONT, AND `break_the_line` IS EXACTLY WHAT ANSWERS IT — the Marchers know both halves and teach them together.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29. ⚠️ Fills the melee gap AND the L3 hole. And it closes a loop: the tradition now has `shieldwork` (make a wall), `held_line` (hold one) and `break_the_line` (break one) — the same knowledge in three directions, which is what a warrior culture whose whole society is honed conflict should look like.
abilities._theHabit_20260830: ⚠️ RANK NAMES STRIPPED OF THE LEADING ARTICLE. ⛔ ERIK HAS CORRECTED MY 'The' HABIT TWICE, and both times I checked CRAFT NAMES ONLY — fourteen RANK names were still carrying it. ✅ The self-check was measuring the wrong field, which is why the habit survived being caught. ⚠️ `reaping_sickle` r3 also collided with `the_known_name` r2 — both were 'The Whole Field'.

abilities.name: Dressed Edge
abilities.description: ⛔ A MARCHER CANNOT CHANGE WHAT A BLADE IS. THEY CAN CHANGE WHAT IS ON IT. Pitch and oil for burning, vitriol from a dyer's shop, grave-filth from the ditch behind a field hospital — dress the edge before the fight and it stops being ONLY steel. ⚠️ THE WEAPON LOSES NOTHING: it keeps its own damage and adds half again in whatever you put on it. ⛔ THIS IS NOT MAGIC AND THE MARCHERS ARE PARTICULAR ABOUT THAT: it is quartermastery, taught beside cooking and boot-repair — and it is the only answer this tradition has to a thing that does not care about steel.
abilities.narrationHints: She spends the evening before with a pot and a rag and does not explain. ⚠️ In the morning the thing that shrugs off spears comes apart where she touches it.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ YOU MUST HAVE THE MATERIAL AND THE TIME — pitch, oil, vitriol, filth: real substances, carried or found, and an evening to prepare. Nothing here is conjured. ⚠️ IT WEARS OFF: a coating lasts a fight, not a campaign, and a blade wiped down or driven through three bodies is bare steel again. ⛔ AND IT DOES NOT STACK — one dressing at a time, and putting acid over pitch gets you a ruined weapon and a lesson.
abilities.plainly: A fight/create action, used WITH a weapon craft. ⛔ THE WEAPON KEEPS ALL ITS OWN DAMAGE AND TYPE, AND THE DRESSING ADDS HALF AGAIN in `heat`, `corrosive` or `decay` — a 2d6 blade becomes 2d6 physical plus 1d6 of the dressing. Rated 5, one weapon, lasts a fight. r2 dresses the whole party's weapons; r3 the dressing holds for days and you carry materials for all three. ⚠️ It deals nothing on its own.

intensity.conserve: a thin dressing — it holds for the opening exchanges only
intensity.surge: ⛔ LAY IT ON HEAVY; the weapon is ruined afterwards and you knew that when you did it

bounds.text: ⛔ REAL MATERIALS AND REAL TIME. Pitch, oil, vitriol, filth — carried or found, and an evening
⛔ IT WEARS OFF. A fight, not a campaign, and a wiped blade is bare steel
⚠️ ONE DRESSING AT A TIME — acid over pitch ruins the weapon
⚠️ IT IS NOT MAGIC AND CANNOT BE MADE TO BE. There is no dressing for `truth`, `psychic` or `abstraction`
⛔ IT DEALS NOTHING ON ITS OWN — no weapon, no dressing. It is an addition to another craft's blow and never a blow itself

crit.success: The dressing does exactly what you hoped to something that has never been hurt before, and it notices.
crit.failure: It takes on your own hands before it takes on anything else.

mechanic.note: setup/empower. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'Marchers need some TYPED OPTIONS. COAT WEAPON with fire, acid, poison etc. That's CONCRETE AND EFFECTIVE.' ⚠️ EVERY MARCHER WEAPON IS `physical` AND THAT IS A REAL VULNERABILITY, recorded in the corpus by play: 'a weapon with no kind resolves as PHYSICAL, and SOME THINGS IN THE WORLD ARE IMMUNE TO PHYSICAL — Silas Weir's Memory spear did 0.00 against the unmoored choir for exactly this reason.' ⛔ THIS IS THE SOLDIER'S ANSWER TO THAT: not magic, MATERIALS. ⚠️ `damageMix` is the authored default (physical .5 / heat .5); the chosen type replaces the second half at use. **It opens ELEMENTAL and VITAL to a tradition that had only PHYSICS.**
mechanic._additiveNotMix_20260829: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'Dressed Edge is a skill that EMPOWERS A WEAPON — which is USED WITH OTHER SKILLS — with various damage types. THE INTENT WAS THAT THIS EMPOWERED TYPE DAMAGE IS ADDITIVE. Maybe adding HALF OF THE BASE WEAPON'S DAMAGE DICE.' ⚠️ I HAD AUTHORED IT AS A 50/50 MIX AND THAT WAS WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: it halved the weapon's own damage (a pitched blade is not a worse blade) and it made the craft a SUBSTITUTE for the weapon rather than an ADDITION to it. ⛔ CORRECT SHAPE: the weapon keeps ALL its own dice and type; the dressing ADDS half again in the chosen type. A 2d6 physical blade dressed with pitch is 2d6 `physical` + 1d6 `heat`. ⚠️ AND THAT IS WHY IT ANSWERS IMMUNITY HONESTLY: against `the_unmoored_choir` (physical: immune) the 2d6 dies and THE 1d6 HEAT LANDS — not because the craft is invisible to the affinity, but because half of what it delivers is a type the creature does not resist. ⛔ `dice: null` ON PURPOSE — THE CRAFT HAS NO DAMAGE OF ITS OWN. It has no weapon to dress without one.
mechanic._notYetReadable: ⛔ `addsTypedDamage` IS PROPOSED AND UNDERSCORE-PREFIXED ON PURPOSE — no engine reads it and I did not declare it in the schema unilaterally. ⚠️ I have invented four fields this week that the engine could not read (`soakBonus`, `mechanic.setup`, `mechanic.ongoingHarm` in the wrong scope, and this), and the pattern is mine: WHEN I WANT A CRAFT TO DO SOMETHING, MY FIRST INSTINCT IS TO AUTHOR A FIELD RATHER THAN ASK WHICH MECHANISM ALREADY DOES IT. ✅ So this one goes to CCode as a spec. ⛔ UNTIL IT IS BUILT: the craft is PROSE that a GM applies — the weapon keeps its damage and adds half again in the dressing's type. Erik's ruling is recorded here; the machinery is not built yet.

tree.name: Dressed Edge
tree.grants: ⛔ DRESS ONE WEAPON: it keeps all its own dice and type, AND ADDS HALF AGAIN in `heat`, `corrosive` or `decay`. ⚠️ Against something that shrugs off steel, the steel still fails and the dressing does not.
tree.cannot: One weapon, one dressing, one fight. ⛔ You must have the material and the evening.

tree.name: Whole Party
tree.grants: ⛔ DRESS EVERY WEAPON IN THE COMPANY BEFORE A FIGHT — and they need not all be the same. ⚠️ A Marcher who knows what is coming sends five people in carrying five answers.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ Material for each. ⛔ And you must know what is coming, or you are guessing five times.

tree.name: Kept Ready
tree.grants: ⛔ THE DRESSING HOLDS FOR DAYS RATHER THAN A FIGHT, and you carry prepared materials for all three — changed in the field, between engagements, without a workshop. ⚠️ This is what a quartermaster is worth, and the Marchers rank it accordingly.
tree.cannot: ⛔ STILL ONE DRESSING PER WEAPON AT A TIME. ⚠️ And carrying vitriol and grave-filth on your person for days has its own consequences.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29. ⚠️ It answers a vulnerability the corpus had already RECORDED FROM PLAY — the Memory spear doing 0.00 against the unmoored choir — and it answers it in the tradition's own idiom: **a Marcher cannot change what a blade is, so they change what is on it.** ⛔ Deliberately L2, both because it is quartermastery rather than mastery and because moving `drawn_bow` and `whats_at_hand` to L3 left the rung thin.

abilities.name: Known Name
abilities.description: ⛔ THEY HAVE HEARD OF YOU, AND IT COSTS THEM. Not a working and not a shout — the plain arithmetic a person does when they recognise the shape walking toward them and remember what was said about it. ⚠️ HANDS GO WRONG. Orders arrive late. The line is a half-step further back than the serjeant told it to be. ⛔ IT WORKS ONLY ON PEOPLE WHO KNOW WHAT YOU HAVE DONE, WHICH IS WHY THE MARCHERS TELL IT (`told_of`) AND WHY THEY ARE PARTICULAR ABOUT TELLING IT TRUE.
abilities.narrationHints: Nobody says the name out loud. ⚠️ The front rank simply stops being a front rank, and the men in it could not tell you when they decided that.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT NEEDS THEM TO KNOW WHO YOU ARE — a stranger feels nothing at all, and this is the craft that makes standing into a weapon rather than a courtesy. ⚠️ AND IT REACHES ONLY WHAT CAN BE AFRAID: the raised, the driven, a mechanism and anything without a self are untouched, exactly as with `break_the_line`. ⛔ Nor does it compel — a frightened person who decides to come anyway comes, and some of the best ones do.
abilities.plainly: A fight/social action. ⛔ ANYONE WHO KNOWS YOUR DEEDS TAKES 2d6 `feeling` AND FIGHTS WORSE while you are in front of them — no armour answers it. Rated 5, a group's worth, about four rounds. r2 reaches everyone who can see you and lasts the engagement; r3 a commander who knows you makes worse decisions, and the effect arrives with the report rather than with you. ⚠️ Only on those who know your name. Nothing that cannot fear.

intensity.surge: ⛔ LET THEM ALL SEE WHO IT IS; every one of them who knows the name takes it, and so does anyone of yours who has heard the worse stories

bounds.text: ⛔ THEY MUST KNOW WHO YOU ARE. A stranger feels nothing — this is standing made into a weapon
⛔ ONLY WHAT CAN BE AFRAID. The raised, the driven and mechanisms are untouched
⚠️ IT DOES NOT COMPEL — a frightened person who comes anyway comes, and the good ones do
⚠️ IT WORKS ON WHAT WAS TOLD, NOT WHAT HAPPENED — a false story reaching them makes them afraid of the wrong thing

crit.success: An entire section decides at once, without conferring, that this is somebody else's fight.
crit.failure: One of them has heard the story where you lost, and says so out loud.

mechanic.note: hobble. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'higher level skills should add some INTRINSIC damage types.' ⚠️ `feeling`, INTRINSIC FAMILY — the first non-physics harm the tradition has ever dealt, and no armour answers it. ⛔ AND IT BRAIDS THE TRADITION'S OWN CRAFTS: `told_of` moves standing, and THIS turns standing into damage — a Marcher who has been telling it true for years arrives already dangerous. ⚠️ Its blind spot is deliberately the same as `break_the_line`'s: neither touches a thing without a self, which is a real reason to send the raised against Marchers.
mechanic._requiresSelfNote: ⛔ `requiresSelf` — PROPOSED, underscore-prefixed: CCode builds the reader and the agreement gate, and I am not declaring a field in the schema unilaterally again. ⚠️ THE CRAFT ALREADY SAYS THIS IN PROSE. Measured 2026-08-30: SIX CRAFTS STATE THE SAME RULE IN FOUR DIFFERENT PHRASINGS — 'without a self', 'has no self', 'anything without a mind', 'anything that does not rely on the man beside it' — and `the_narrowed` states the other half as `feeling: immune` IN DATA. ⛔ NOTHING CHECKS THE TWO AGREE AND NOTHING EVER WILL WHILE ONE SIDE IS PROSE. ✅ With `hasSelf` on the bestiary classes, a gate can assert it: every craft requiring a self must be answered by every creature that has none. ⚠️ ERIK'S TEST, WHICH THIS PASSES: does it let content say ONCE what it currently says many times in prose?

tree.name: Known Name
tree.grants: ⛔ ANYONE FACING YOU WHO KNOWS YOUR DEEDS TAKES 2d6 `feeling` AND FIGHTS WORSE. ⚠️ No armour answers it, and nobody has to say anything.
tree.cannot: They must know you. ⛔ Nothing without a self. ⚠️ And it does not stop anyone who decides to come.

tree.name: Whole Field
tree.grants: ⛔ EVERYONE WHO CAN SEE YOU AND KNOWS THE NAME, FOR THE WHOLE ENGAGEMENT. ⚠️ This is why a known Marcher is placed where they can be SEEN rather than where they fight best.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ Line of sight, and they must still know you. ⛔ Strangers keep coming normally.

tree.name: Before You Arrive
tree.grants: ⛔ A COMMANDER WHO KNOWS YOU MAKES WORSE DECISIONS — and it arrives with the REPORT rather than with you. ⚠️ Garrisons abandon posts you were never going to reach.
tree.cannot: ⛔ IT IS STILL ONLY WHAT THEY BELIEVE. ⚠️ A commander who has met you and was unimpressed is immune, and will say so to everyone.

Erik: 'make sure you're authoring with FULL SCHEMA CORRECTNESS.' ⚠️ ALL NINE ABILITIES I AUTHORED THIS SESSION WERE INCOMPLETE — the merged three missing axes/notFor/operativeAxis/bounds and every rank missing gains/harmRung; the six ranged missing cannot/functions/gains/harmRung on every rank. ⛔ I CHECKED THE CONTENT AND NOT THE SHAPE, which is the same failure as verifying content and not address.

_scopeRebalance: ⛔ SNG-488: scope was 18 of 81 Body gains, drifting back to the lazy default corrected in Mind (§32.4). ⚠️ In most cases scope was doing TARGETS' job — 'a group', 'a party', 'everyone in reach' are counts, not areas.
_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
